text_block_list.text:
I was preparing to hand over training 
materials to Mejiro Ramonu, but...
choice_data_list:
Sorry, another matter came up so I 
couldn't hand it over no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――No problem... It is not an issue. Ramonu 
is... my roommate.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"Ramonu—I have something for you, from 
your... Trainer—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“――Yes, that's right. Next, let's aim for 
this lap time.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Both in her form and race management. 
There's—less waste—than before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Really? ...So, what was it you were 
holding onto for me?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A good... Trainer, you must have. To think 
they could make you make... such a face.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I suppose my love for racing runs deep.
